question.problem: Given the sphere $(x-3)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}+(z-2)^{2}=9,$ what is the domain of $z=z(x,y)?$

choices.value: The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $\sqrt{3}$ centered at $(1,3)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $\sqrt{3}$ centered at $(-3,1)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $\sqrt{3}$ centered at $(3,2)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $3$ centered at $(1,-3)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $3$ centered at $(3,1)$
